description: This Java class defines a REST controller for managing products in an e-commerce application. It includes endpoints for creating, deleting, retrieving, and filtering products, as well as managing product reviews, options, manufacturers, and categories. The class interacts with service layers to perform business logic and uses Spring annotations for request mapping and dependency injection.

classes.name: ShopProductRESTController
classes.description: REST controller providing API endpoints for managing products, manufacturers, options, reviews, and categories within an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new product for a specified merchant store, populating entities from received DTO and persisting via service layer.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID from a specified merchant store if it exists.

methods.name: createManufacturer
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturer associated with a merchant store, populating from DTO and persisting.

methods.name: createProductOptionValue
methods.description: Creates a new product option value for a specified store.

methods.name: createProductOption
methods.description: Creates a new product option for a specific store.

methods.name: createProductReview
methods.description: Adds a new review to a product, with validation to prevent duplicates and rating constraints.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of products for a category with optional language and store filtering.

methods.name: getProductsFilteredByType
methods.description: Retrieves a filtered list of products based on predefined filters such as brand.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Internal method to fetch products with detailed filtering, filtering by category, manufacturer, and other criteria.
